story.heading: One kitchen, two cuisines
paragraphs: Eastern Dragon serves North Wales from Upper State Road with a menu that refuses to pick a side: Chinese classics on one page, sushi and tempura on the next.
Call one of the two lines, order online, or walk in and read the coupon board, then take it home while it is still steaming.

experience.heading: The fast way to dinner
items: Order online or call ahead, then pick up at the counter.
Lunch specials move quickly, so the kitchen keeps them simple and hot.
Feedback and coupons both live on the official site.

feature.heading: The Dragon Roll
feature.text: The house roll is the reason the name is on the sign. Order it beside Mongolian Beef and the menu makes sense.

closing.heading: Order online or call (215) 855-0366
closing.kicker: North Wales, on Upper State Road
